# vscode-twoslash-queries A tiny (75LOC) extension for VS Code that lets you use `// ^?` inside your editor to inline highlight types. Re-uses the existing TypeScript tooling infra in `*.ts`, `*.tsx`, `*.js`, and `*.jsx` files, simply adding inline info. Useful for keyboard warriors or folks working on complex types and want to see how changes propagate throughout other types. ## Features You write `// ^?` anywhere in a source file (with whitespace before, between and middle being whatever) all that matters is the alignment of the `^`.
